prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 79.1%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 83.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 77.3%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 91.9%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 30.3%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Overlay Interaction Sandbox Screen: Adds a new interactive desktop sandbox screen before finish where users directly test pet controls, hiding, and talking commands. (why: 3 support tickets noted confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to pets after onboarding, and the finish step has a low 64.8% conversion.)
1: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Pet Control Audio-Visual Guided Tour Flow: Introduces an audio-visual guidance flow on the home intro screen showcasing shortcuts to manage desktop pets. (why: Multiple users emailed support after onboarding complaining that controlling, hiding, or speaking to the pet was unclear.)
2: [choose_path, reorder] Story Intro First Path Selector Sequence Reorder: Reorders onboarding to highlight the story companion screen before selecting a path. (why: The choose_path step takes a mean of 514 seconds with a 79.1% completion rate, indicating users need clearer context upfront.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account Sign In Pet Preservation Notice Banner: Adds a clear hint banner explaining that signing in preserves existing pets and prevents account resets. (why: 8 support tickets (the largest issue category) reported pets missing or being reset after signing back into an account.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Overlay Rendering Progress Indicator Callout: Displays time estimates and rendering tips on the waiting screen during desktop initialization. (why: Users spend a median of 201 seconds and mean of 2,336 seconds waiting for engine initialization.)
5: [finish, copy] Desktop Pet Controls Quick Reference Copy: Updates headline, body, and button copy on the finish screen to detail main desktop hotkeys and mouse actions. (why: Finish screen conversion drops to 64.8% and post-onboarding support is filled with control confusion.)
6: [adoption, layout] Pet Adoption Name Input Split Layout: Switches the adoption certificate screen to a split layout focused on pet naming and registration. (why: Adoption step has a 77.3% completion rate and takes a mean of 1,017 seconds.)
7: [home, notification] Desktop Background Engine Completion Sound Notification: Enables audio notifications and system alerts when the desktop pet finishes background rendering. (why: Long wait times (mean 2,336s) cause users to switch windows and abandon the app while waiting.)

scores.note: Finish loses 35.2% of users and support confirms confusion, but adding a screen is high cost.
Guided tour addresses finish confusion but requires complex new flow implementation.
Reorders choose_path to fix 20.9% drop-off, though support emails don't mention it.
Strong support evidence (8 tickets) and simple hint banner config to reduce sign_in anxiety.
Addresses high 2,336s wait time at home step with clear wait time callout.
Combines largest funnel drop step (35.2% loss at finish) with strong support evidence and cheap copy tweak.
Split layout targets 22.7% drop-off at adoption step, supported by funnel duration data.
Audio alerts bring back users multitasking during the 2,336s mean home rendering wait.
